ap_physics_c_mechanics-f01.title: Position and velocity graphs of a block on a spring

stimulus.description: A block of mass $m=1\text{ kg}$ is attached to a horizontal ideal spring of spring constant $k=100\text{ N/m}$ on a frictionless surface. The block is pulled to $x=+A$ with $A=0.2\text{ m}$ and released from rest at $t=0$. Blank axes are provided on the answer sheet.

parts.label: A
parts.prompt: On the axes provided, sketch the position $x$ and the velocity $v$ of the block as functions of time $t$ for one full period (use two separate sets of axes stacked vertically with the same time scale). Label the amplitudes and the period.
parts.model_answer: $x(t)$ is a cosine starting at $+0.2\text{ m}$ with period $T=0.63\text{ s}$; $v(t)$ is a negative sine, zero at $t=0$, reaching $-2.00\text{ m/s}$ at $T/4$.

rubric_rows.criterion: Both sets of axes are labeled with quantities and units and share the same time scale
The position graph is a cosine that starts at $+A=0.2\text{ m}$
common_errors: starts at zero like a sine

rubric_rows.criterion: The velocity graph is zero at $t=0$ and first becomes negative, reaching about $-2.00\text{ m/s}$ at a quarter period
common_errors: draws the velocity as a positive cosine

rubric_rows.criterion: The period is marked as about $0.63\text{ s}$ on the time axis

parts.label: B
parts.prompt: Derive an expression for the maximum speed of the block in terms of $A$, $k$ and $m$.

rubric_rows.criterion: Identifies the angular frequency $\omega=\sqrt{k/m}$ (or sets the initial elastic energy $\tfrac12kA^2$ equal to the maximum kinetic energy)
Differentiates the position function to find the velocity $v=-A\omega\sin\omega t$ (or writes the kinetic energy at the equilibrium position)
required_elements: v = - A omega sin omega t
common_errors: differentiates cos to sin without the factor omega

rubric_rows.criterion: Obtains $v_{max}=A\sqrt{k/m}$

parts.label: C
parts.prompt: Calculate the period, the maximum speed and the magnitude of the maximum acceleration of the block.

rubric_rows.criterion: Calculates the period of about 0.63 with units of seconds
Calculates the maximum speed of about 2.00 with units of meters per second
Calculates the maximum acceleration of about 20.00 with units of meters per second squared

parts.label: D
parts.prompt: The block is replaced by one with four times the mass and released from the same position. Predict by what factors the period and the maximum speed change, and justify your answer.
parts.model_answer: The period doubles and the maximum speed is halved, because $T=2\pi\sqrt{m/k}$ and $v_{max}=A\sqrt{k/m}$ depend on $m$ through $\sqrt{m}$.

rubric_rows.criterion: States that the period doubles (a factor of 2) and the maximum speed is halved (a factor of 1/2)
common_errors: states a factor of 4 for the period

rubric_rows.criterion: Justifies with $T\propto\sqrt{m}$ and $v_{max}\propto1/\sqrt{m}$ (same stored energy shared with a larger mass)
common_errors: argues only that the heavier block is slower
